children: NextDC loses its bulls at Morgan Stanley on worries over the data-center operator's debt. Cutting their rating to equal-weight from overweight, MS analysts say risk reward has shifted meaningfully with the surprise news that its M3 center will not expand to schedule. They had expected the A$5 billion of recent capital expenditure to support a positive earnings inflection point over fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2028. They no longer have high conviction. The analysts tell clients in a note that the stock's hefty selloff could represent an opportunity, but warn it is high risk. MS slashes its target price 65% to 6.70 Australian dollars. Shares are down 7% at A$5.35.(stuart.condie@wsj.com)
